title: 'When this is ... discarded, draw 1' does not trigger
expected: Scrapheap's ability is parsed (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/trigger-patterns.ts:271) into the synthetic trigger event "play-discard-or-die-self". The engine matcher (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/trigger-matcher.ts:218-228) splits compound events on "-or-", yielding ["play-discard","die-self"] — neither equals the engine's "discard" (nor "die"/"play-self") event, so triggerMatchesEvent returns false and no draw fires. Verified: registry shows abilities=[{trigger:{event:"play-discard-or-die-self",on:"self"},effect:{type:"draw",amount:1}}], and the existing test.failing case "discarded from hand by your own effect draws 1" in src/__tests__/cards/ogn-182-298.test.ts still passes as failing (bun test: 6 pass). Fix: emit event "play-self-or-discard-or-die" in the parser pattern (or map it in EVENT_MAP/split normalization).
observed: Scrapheap went to trash via reveal-and-pick discard; deck stayed 34, hand 6->5, no trigger

history.note: already fixed upstream: trigger-patterns emits play-self-or-discard-or-die; all 6 ogn-182-298 tests pass
